warning[ZBX-W0902]: a damaged trust record was kept; its tree is in the store
  cause  /home/alice/.local/share/zbx/trust/signatures/0123456789abcdef is
         damaged, or of a newer zbx, but its tree is in the store, so it was
         kept
  fix    import the tree's bundle again or sign it again; upgrade zbx if newer
